payload: {"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:22c19fedafd73da27cb86945d8ae6002202fd4f4e75d22ce8d4097bd19d00d46","learning_id":"PL-070","learning":"Code that calls LAN services via raw urllib silently fails on swarm overlay (no LAN reachability). Required surface: lan-proxy KNOWN_HTTP_TARGETS allowlist must match real port (port-scan before encoding, dont trust comments). {"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:d1bd50f5cb03c4fd11689b77c4d9d6a3d6f8f83ff947a23c2dd586c43abb359f","learning_id":"PL-071","learning":"Module-level circuit-breaker singletons in production code accumulate state across pytest runs (RemoteCircuitBreaker stores _consecutive_failures + _opened_at on the instance). Test files that exercise these breakers need an @pytest.fixture(autouse=True) that calls breaker.record_success() before+after each test, otherwise URLError tests open the breaker and downstream tests short-circuit before mocked urlopen fires (IndexError on m.call_args_list). Pattern applies to any of the 17 breakers in this project — future breaker test files should follow the same shape. Surfaced by T-804 P-011 first-unit-run; pre-existed silently because subset runs (-k filter) never tripped the threshold.","task":"T-805","source":"P-001","date":"2026-05-03"}

{"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:d1bd50f5cb03c4fd11689b77c4d9d6a3d6f8f83ff947a23c2dd586c43abb359f","learning_id":"PL-072","learning":"Playwright page.goto waits for load event by default. Fire-and-forget fetches initiated synchronously during page load (e.g. .then().catch() pattern) still block the load event because the browser tracks the in-flight XHR. If the slow fetch is cosmetic enrichment (health badges, secondary data), wrap initiation in setTimeout-deferred window.addEventListener(load) with once:true to decouple Playwright wait semantics from server-side latency. Symptom: Playwright timeout despite fast direct curl. Diagnostic: time each fetch the destination page initiates client-side; check for sync fire-and-forget patterns.","task":"T-817","source":"PL-031","date":"2026-05-04"}

{"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:d1bd50f5cb03c4fd11689b77c4d9d6a3d6f8f83ff947a23c2dd586c43abb359f","learning_id":"PL-073","learning":"When a Playwright test reports element-not-populated within N seconds, FIRST verify the element exists at all. page.query_selector returning None is indistinguishable from element-exists-but-empty in the failure log. Stale selector vs. backend outage are completely different bugs that fail-alias into the same symptom. Diagnostic order: (1) does the selector match anything on the live page, (2) if yes, is it being populated, (3) only then suspect the data source.","task":"T-772","source":"PL-073","date":"2026-05-04"}

{"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:d1bd50f5cb03c4fd11689b77c4d9d6a3d6f8f83ff947a23c2dd586c43abb359f","learning_id":"PL-074","learning":"When building diagnostic surfaces (test output, dashboard cards, Drift Watch rows), distinguish failure modes from each other so the operator can act without re-investigating. A single boolean working/broken collapses (a) selector-doesn-not-match, (b) selector-matches-but-empty, (c) selector-matches-but-loading, (d) selector-matches-real-outage into the same signal — invisibly aliasing four different bug classes. Each class has a different fix path. The cost of adding distinguishing fields is low (one bool + one print branch); the cost of debugging an aliased failure is high (T-772 stale selector hid behind SSE-outage signature for unknown duration).","task":"T-818","source":"PL-074","date":"2026-05-04"}

{"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:d1bd50f5cb03c4fd11689b77c4d9d6a3d6f8f83ff947a23c2dd586c43abb359f","learning_id":"PL-075","learning":"When a probe emits a user-facing URL, verification must include 'does the URL render' (HTTP 200/3xx) not just 'is the URL emitted'. T-822 shipped a /projects/<name>/builds/<n> click-through that 500ed because OneDev 13.1.5 parses that segment as numeric project ID; canonical form is /<name>/~builds/<n>. Schema-level checks passed; semantic check (URL renders) was missing.","task":"T-823","source":"","date":"2026-05-04"}

{"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:22c19fedafd73da27cb86945d8ae6002202fd4f4e75d22ce8d4097bd19d00d46","learning_id":"PL-076","learning":"Diagnose CI deploy errors at endpoint level before assuming config drift — silenced stderr in aws-cli (2>/dev/null) hid garage-1 connection failure on build #882; downstream grep on empty input misled toward 'token missing in S3' when the real cause was single-endpoint hardcoding to a dead node. When error message format conflates 'fetch returned empty' and 'fetch returned content but key missing', operator hypothesis is misdirected. Use distinct messages and dont silence stderr on infrastructure-touching shell calls.","task":"T-826","source":"","date":"2026-05-04"}

{"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:d1bd50f5cb03c4fd11689b77c4d9d6a3d6f8f83ff947a23c2dd586c43abb359f","learning_id":"PL-077","learning":"verify command pattern curl piped to grep -q falsely fails under fw set -euo pipefail when response exceeds pipe buffer because grep -q SIGPIPEs curl. {"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:22c19fedafd73da27cb86945d8ae6002202fd4f4e75d22ce8d4097bd19d00d46","learning_id":"PL-078","learning":"Probe before changing infrastructure config — DNS authoritatively names the right IP even when the host is stopped; circuit-open on a closed breaker is the system working, not a bug. {"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:22c19fedafd73da27cb86945d8ae6002202fd4f4e75d22ce8d4097bd19d00d46","learning_id":"PL-084","learning":"Anchor-pair completeness: when wiring an Action Required link to a route that does not yet exist, ALWAYS file a follow-up build task for the missing surface in the same session — do not let the workaround link harden into a long-lived broken target. The fix loop is: (1) link emit, (2) workaround to nearest existing surface, (3) follow-up task created, (4) follow-up ships, (5) link reverts to canonical. T-854 -> T-855 closed this loop end-to-end; the lesson is to never stop at step 2.","task":"T-855","source":"PL","date":"2026-05-06"}

{"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:22c19fedafd73da27cb86945d8ae6002202fd4f4e75d22ce8d4097bd19d00d46","learning_id":"PL-087","learning":"Live-monitor freshness caption pattern — when adding the  ticker to a page, track success on the 30s-tier critical fetches only (the ones operators stare at). {"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:d1bd50f5cb03c4fd11689b77c4d9d6a3d6f8f83ff947a23c2dd586c43abb359f","learning_id":"PL-088","learning":"Action Required side-file enrichment pattern: when watchdog drift Action Required entries show vague counts (N stopped, N degraded, N rotting), enrich them by reading the existing .context/watchdog/SIDE.json side-file already populated by the probe. {"origin_project":"ring20-dashboard","origin_hub_fingerprint":"sha256:22c19fedafd73da27cb86945d8ae6002202fd4f4e75d22ce8d4097bd19d00d46","learning_id":"PL-089","learning":"Action Required signal-exposure pattern (T-867 circuit-breaker open-duration; T-868 FritzBox WAN connection state) — distinct from PL-088 enrichment.
